$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only), each a search people type with its own Google-indexed page (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Task names are unique per account, so each ends in all-job-boards. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.
